item.title: Interfaze: A new model architecture built for high accuracy at scale
item.description:
📝 tl;dr: Interfaze is a new model architecture that outperforms models like Gemini-3-Flash, Claude-Sonnet-4. Transformer models are similar. Interfaze outperforms OCR providers like Chandra OCR and Reducto, and generalist models like Gemini-3-Flash and GPT-5.
🔗 Read more: https://interfaze.ai/blog/interfaze-a-new-model-architecture-built-for-high-accuracy-at-scale
